page.layout: One page of text (left printed page, page 70) with a running head "AP" centred at top; a narrow column of marginal notes on the right edge of the scan (Greek and Latin references, partly cut off by the binding and the right-hand page); no catchword legible at foot except a partial word "Αρχισεω-" at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: ἄρσεν ἐ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτὰς, marem & fœminam fecit eos.
Ἀρσενοκοίτης ὁ cinædus. ex ἄρσεν ἐν τὸ mas & κοίτης ἡ cubile, concubitus, 1.Cor.6.9.
Ἀρτέμων ὁν ὁ artemo. h.e. velum navis maximum, Act.27.40.
Ἄρτι nunc, modò, adhuc adv. 1. Joh.2.9. ἕως ἄρτι hucusque, 1.Cor.4.11. ἄχρι τὴν ἄρτι ὥρας, ad hoc usque tempus, Johan.1.52. ἀπ' ἄρτι ex hoc tempore, & Joh.13.19. ἀπ' ἄρτι jam nunc nuper, 1.Thess.3.6.
Ἀρτιγέννητος ὁ ἡ recens genitus, modò natus. ex ἄρτι nunc, & γεννητὸς generatus, 1.Pet.2.2.
Ἀρτιος α ον perfectus a um, 2.Tim.3.17.
Ἀρτίω condio. F. ἠρτίσω. P. ἠρτυκα. A.1. ἠρτυσα. P.pass. ἠρτυμαι. part. prat. pass. ἠρτυμένος conditus, Col.4.6.

Ἀρχάγγελος ὁ archangelus, q.d. ἀρχων ἀγγέλων, princeps angelorum. componitur ex ἀρχὴ & ἄγγελος. ἀρχὴ idem est quod ἀρχων princeps, sed extra compositionem non est usitatum. Nominibus vero, cum quibus componitur, præponi solet, Jud.v.9.
Ἀρχαῖος α ον antiquus a um, Actor.15.7. ἀφ' ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων, jam pridem.
Ἀρχὴ ῆς ἡ principium, principatus, imperium, extremum seu extrema pars, Act.10.11.
Ἀρχηγὸς ὁ princeps, Actor.3.15. ex ἀρχων & ἡγέομαι duco.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and largely illegible (Greek glosses with references such as "Marc.2.", "Act.16.1.", "Th.", "Joh.", "vide infra"); not transcribed in full. Greek accents in several words are doubtful and may be misread. The right-hand printed page (partly visible, with notes) is not transcribed.
